mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_channel_members (channel_id, user_id, role) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{userId}, #{role}) ON CONFLICT (channel_id, user_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT m.user_id, m.role, m.joined_at, u.name AS user_name FROM chat_channel_members m LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = m.user_id WHERE m.channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY m.role ASC, m.joined_at ASC
SELECT count(*) FROM chat_channel_members WHERE channel_id = #{channelId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM chat_channel_members WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} AND user_id = #{userId}
